subject: Re: KnowNo status: shaping the Jul 8 ship/hold call
body:
Team,

Ahead of the Jul 8 readout, here's where I've landed so we can pressure-test it together.

Shadow-mode numbers Rosa pulled Friday: at the 90% completion target, the wrapped workflow asks for help on 13.8% of tasks versus the 31% clarification rate of the current heuristic — a better experience AND a formal guarantee behind it. That's a ship story.

Proposed ship criteria (the decision I'll take into the room):
1) Ship to the one calibrated workflow only. Every new workflow gets its own calibration set — no guarantee transfer, full stop.
2) Vera's monthly recalibration job is a launch blocker, not a fast-follow. A silently weakening guarantee is worse than no guarantee.
3) Help-request UX copy goes through the trust review since we're now telling users "the system is unsure."

If anyone disagrees with 2 being a blocker, bring data Thursday. Otherwise this goes in as written.

Priya
